{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches only release notes (doc/release-notes-36861.md) accompanying a code change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates that accompany code changes do not make the PR a member of the docs category."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "src/node/mempool_args.cpp and src/test/mempool_tests.cpp validate mempool CLI/config arguments like -mempoolexpiry and -datacarriersize.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.2,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Validates mempool configuration parameters at startup rather than altering mempool data structures or policy algorithms. It prevents negative `-mempoolexpiry` from causing immediate transaction expiry, but represents minor startup sanitization from a mempool perspective."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "src/init.cpp and subsystem argument helper files overhaul startup argument validation and string-to-integral parsing.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fails node startup cleanly when invalid or out-of-range numeric arguments are provided. As detailed in commit 830af36b82, silent integer narrowing and sign wrapping previously caused critical runtime malfunctions like disabled database flushing (-dbbatchsize) and nodes trapped in IBD (-maxtipage)."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications in src/node/chainstatemanager_args.cpp and src/node/coins_view_args.cpp handle startup options rather than core consensus or validation logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Startup option validation that passes through chainstate argument helpers without altering validation invariants or block connection does not qualify as validation work."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "src/wallet/init.cpp, src/wallet/wallet.cpp, and test/functional/wallet_fallbackfee.py update parsing of wallet configuration options like -txconfirmtarget.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.15,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents out-of-bounds wallet configuration options from silently forcing transactions to fallback fees. The change is isolated to wallet startup argument checking rather than wallet core logic."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,

  }
}
